classification.difficultyReason: Convert the northwest bearing to 44 degrees west of north and identify the west and north components as opposite and adjacent sides.

content.prompt: During an orienteering competition, Fran runs 1600 m on a bearing of $316^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$ from checkpoint 1 to checkpoint 2.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How far west of checkpoint 1 is checkpoint 2, correct to the nearest metre?

answer.worked:
The route is $360^{\circ}-316^{\circ}=44^{\circ}$ west of north. Let $w$ be the distance west, in metres.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{w}{1600}&=\sin44^{\circ}\\w&=1600\sin44^{\circ}\\w&\approx1111\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: How far north of checkpoint 1 is checkpoint 2, correct to the nearest metre?

answer.worked:
The route makes an angle of $44^{\circ}$ with north. Let $n$ be the distance north, in metres.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{n}{1600}&=\cos44^{\circ}\\n&=1600\cos44^{\circ}\\n&\approx1151\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
